title: Barnett Outdoors Recalls Crossbows Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The sensor that senses whether an arrow is properly loaded can malfunction, which can cause the crossbow to fire unexpectedly, posing an injury hazard to the user or bystander. Units: About 3,300.

title: Masterbuilt Recalls LP Gas Smokers Due To Fire Hazard
summary: The smoker's gas hose can disconnect posing a fire hazard. Units: About 41,000.

title: Yankee Candle Recalls Luminous Candles Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: When the candle is lit, the glass jar can crack, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 31,000 (in addition, about 300 units were sold in Canada).

title: Playworld Recalls Stainless Steel Playground Slides Due to Amputation Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The weld between the slide bedway and sidewall can crack and separate. A child's fingers can get caught in the space, posing an amputation hazard. Units: About 1,300.

title: Schurman Retail Group Recalls Gift Boxes Due to Risk of Mold Exposure
summary: Mold can be present on the boxes, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in individuals with compromised immune systems, damaged lungs or an allergy to mold. Units: About 8,400 (in addition, about 2 were sold in Canada).

title: Atrium Recalls SafeHarbor Windows Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The glass can separate from the frame during hurricane conditions, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 580.

title: Target Reannounces Recall of Menorahs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The menorahs can melt when the candles are burning, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,600 (previously recalled in May 2016).

title: Baby Bath Seats/Chairs Recalled Due to Drowning Hazard; Made by Lexibook (Recall Alert)
summary: The bath seats/chairs fail to meet the federal safety standard, including requirements for stability and the bath seats can tip over while a baby is in it, posing a drowning hazard to babies. Units: About 7,000.

title: LED Lamps Recalled by Technical Consumer Products Due to Electrical Shock Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Habitat for Humanity in California
summary: The lamps can overheat exposing an energized heat-sink and wires, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 39,000.

title: Valspar Recalls Wood Cleaner and Wood Brightener Products Due to Chemical Hazard
summary: A faulty cap seal can cause the containers to leak contents, posing a chemical hazard to consumers. Inhaling, ingesting or skin contact with the product can cause burning and other injuries. Units: About 10,300.

title: 4 Sizzle Recalls Promotional Charcoal Grills Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The grill can catch on fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,700.

title: Aria Child Recalls Strollers Due to Laceration and Fall Hazards
summary: A gap in the stroller's folding side hinge can pinch a caregiver's hand during unfolding, posing a laceration hazard. In addition, the stroller can fold unexpectedly during use, posing an injury and fall hazard to the caregiver and child. Units: About 29,400.

title: Carbon Express Recalls Crossbows Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The crossbow can fire unexpectedly when the safety is engaged, posing an injury hazard to the user or bystander. Units: About 3,800.

title: Zebra Technologies Recalls Power Supply Units for Thermal Printers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power supply units can degrade and corrode over time when exposed to moisture and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 166,000.

title: LG Electronics Recalls Portable Air Conditioners Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The portable air conditioners can overheat, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 466,000 (In addition, 36,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Craftsman Brand Chainsaws Recalled by MTD Southwest Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The chainsaws can leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 19,500.

title: Figi's Companies Recalls "Christmas Wishes" Tins Due to Choking and Button Battery Ingestion Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The tin's music sound chip mechanism can separate and expose button batteries, posing choking and button battery ingestion hazards to children. Units: About 5,000.

title: Remington Brand Chainsaws Recalled by MTD Southwest Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The chainsaws can leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,000.

title: Trek Recalls Bicycle Lights Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The bicycle light can operate intermittently when paired with a remote transmitter, reducing the visibility of and for the rider, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 600.

title: Chicken Toys Recalled by Bingo Deals Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The toys contain small eggs and the chicken can break into small plastic pieces, both posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 2,700.

title: Cuisinart Food Processors Recalled by Conair Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The food processor's riveted blade can crack over time and small metal pieces of the blade can break off into the processed food. This poses a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 8 million (in addition, about 300,000 were sold in Canada).

title: World Trading Recalls Orbit Self-Balancing Scooters/Hoverboards Due to Fire Hazard; Sold by Evine
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: 1900.

title: GLOPO Recalls Children's Scooters Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front wheels of the scooter can detach when riding, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 520.

title: Polaris Recalls Sportsman 570 All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The air intake duct can contact the fuel rail and cause a fuel leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 9,900.

title: Suzuki Recalls KingQuad ATVs Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The ATV's battery can fail and cause the engine to stop running while in use, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 3,400.

title: Tea Collection Recalls Children's Denim Jackets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal snaps on the jackets can detach, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 500 (in addition, about 25 were sold in Canada).
